Compare GO and DEG in the Attalah (immature) and McConnell (mature) gametophyte samples

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggVennDiagram)
```

## DEGs

```{r}
atallah_deg <- read_csv("../output/DEG_ALL_Atallah.csv.gz")
# note "up" is plus antheridogen

mcconnell_deg <- read_csv("../../McConnell_Samples/output/DEG_ALL_WT_male_v_herm.csv.gz")
# note "up" is hermaphrodites
```

Venn Diagram
```{r}
venn_list <- list(
  McConnell_hermaphrodite = mcconnell_deg %>% filter(FDR < 0.01, logFC > 0) %>% pull(geneID),
  Atallah_ctrl = atallah_deg %>% filter(FDR < 0.01, logFC < 0) %>% pull(geneID),
  Atallah_antheridogen = atallah_deg %>% filter(FDR < 0.01, logFC > 0) %>% pull(geneID),
  McConnell_male = mcconnell_deg %>% filter(FDR < 0.01, logFC < 0) %>% pull(geneID)
  )

v_data <- process_data(Venn(venn_list))


category_names = c("McConnell\nhermaphrodite", "Atallah\ncontrol", "Atallah\nantheridogen", "McConnell\nmale")

ggplot() +
  # 1. region count layer
  geom_polygon(aes(X, Y, fill = count, group = id), 
          data = venn_regionedge(v_data)) +
  # 2. set edge layer
  geom_path(aes(X, Y, color = id, group = id), 
          data = venn_setedge(v_data), 
          show.legend = FALSE) +
  # 3. set label layer
  geom_text(aes(X, Y*1.02, label = category_names), 
               data = venn_setlabel(v_data)) +
  # 4. region label layer
  geom_label(aes(X, Y, label = count), 
             fill = "grey90",
                data = venn_regionlabel(v_data)) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void() +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .2)) 

ggsave("../Atallah_McConnell_Venn.pdf")
ggsave("../Atallah_McConnell_Venn.png")
```

## GOs

```{r}
atallah_go_antheridogen <- read_csv("../output/GO_up_antheridogen_Atallah.csv") #empty
atallah_go_control <- read_csv("../output/GO_down_antheridogen_Atallah.csv")
mcconnell_go_male <- read_csv("../../McConnell_Samples/output/GO_down_WT_male_v_herm.csv") # 1 row
mcconnell_go_hermaphrodites <- read_csv("../../McConnell_Samples/output/GO_up_WT_male_v_herm.csv")
```

```{r}
atallah_go_control <- atallah_go_control %>%
  mutate(enrichment=numDEInCat/numInCat) %>%
  select(term, enrichment, FDR)

mcconnell_go_hermaphrodites <- mcconnell_go_hermaphrodites %>%
  mutate(enrichment=numDEInCat/numInCat) %>%
  select(term, enrichment, FDR)

ctrl_herm_combined <- bind_rows(Atallah = atallah_go_control, McConnell = mcconnell_go_hermaphrodites,.id="data_set")
```

```{r}
ctrl_herm_combined %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(enrich_max = max(enrichment, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(term=fct_reorder(term, enrich_max, .desc = FALSE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=data_set, y = term, size = enrichment, color = -log10(FDR))) +
  geom_point()

ggsave("../output/Atallah_McConnell_GO_herm_ctrl.pdf")
ggsave("../output/Atallah_McConnell_GO_herm_ctrl.png")
```
